teaser: Today, the Honourable Dominic LeBlanc, President of the King’s Privy Council for Canada and Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Intergovernmental Affairs, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy, and the Honourable Janice Charette, Chief Trade Negotiator to the United States, met with representatives of the North American automobile industry from the Canadian Vehicles Manufacturers’ Association and the American Automotive Policy Council.
title: Minister LeBlanc and Chief Trade Negotiator Charette meet with North American auto industry representatives ahead of upcoming CUSMA joint review
